text: Sometimes the greatest blessing is simply realizing that you made it through something you once thought would break you.
Thank you Lord Jesus & Mama Mary 🙏 Please hear my prayers 😇
Thankyou LordGod in heaven for all your goodness mercy kindness love towards all your children of God including my children family and my family and there’s no other God like you do , Amen 🙏

Manifesting never worked for me and I felt genuinely crap about it. Watched everyone else talk about it like it was second nature while I just sat there feeling broken. Took Sara Rivers arche type quiz purely out of desperation, honestly didn't expect anything. Matched me exactly. Like, uncomfortably exact. Didn't see that coming at all. If you've been beating yourself up over this too, just try it. Costs you two minutes. ❤
Any possibility these songs are in a piano book so I can play on my piano???

"Let everything that has breath praise the LORD."  
                   ~ Psalm 150 : 6 🙏✝🙏

"Give thanks to Yahweh, for He is good, for His loving kindness endures forever."  
                                            ~ Psalm 107 : 1  🙏✝🙏

"I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being." 
                                                               ~ Psalm 104 : 33 🙏✝🙏

I'm not gonna pretend I had it all figured out, because I didn't. Manifesting felt like failing for years. I'd try, get nowhere, tell myself I'd get it next time, and then nothing again. It got to the point where I figured maybe some people just aren't wired for it and I was one of them. Then I took Vera Hart's archetype quiz, kind of as a last thing to try. And it hit something. My archetype just fit, in a way that made me go oh. No fireworks, no life suddenly fixed. But for the first time I had direction instead of just fumbling in the dark hoping something would stick. If you're struggling with it too, honestly, do the quiz. Its free anyway.
